title: Creating Security Permissions

children:
You can create user security records on the Security Permissions Window.  When a user attempts to access a SCALE window, the system determines if they have any user-level security records. If an employee has a user-level record, 
 the system will apply that record each time the employee attempts to access the window. User-level security  limits a 
 single employee's ability to access and/or perform actions on a specific 
 window. Or, the Security Permissions Window can be used to define the security rights of a specific security group. Processing and/or configurations are defined for the security group and what security checkpoints can be used for the group. These are all defined using the Security Permissions Window.

Mass security changes are also allowed using this window. The system allows you to select the processing or configuration windows and assigning security to them. All of the selected forms (windows) will be assigned the selected security levels and actions.
This window allows you to grant security permissions by a specific processing function or by a specific configuration.
The following is discussed in this topic:
Copying a User Profile to a Security Permissions to Group or User

Open the Security Permissions Window. The upper half of this window displays the system windows that 
 you can create security records for.
Access a specific window's settings by selecting it from the list.

When 
 you select a record from the list, the system displays all security 
 records defined for this window.

To create a new 
 record, select the New Action from the record list.

Use the Security 
 Level Field to indicate if you want to create a user, group or system-level 
 security record.

Use the User 
 Name Field to select the user that you are creating the security 
 record for. When you create a system-level record, this field is deactivated.
Use the Group Name Field to select the group you are creating the security record for.

Use the checkboxes 
 on the General Tab to assign permission to this user for basic 
 window functions, such as run, copy or delete. Note that to allow a user 
 to open a window, you must select the action "Run."

Use the checkboxes 
 on the Form Specific Tab to select the specific advanced action(s) 
 that you want to allow this user to perform on this window. Note that 
 not all windows will have form-specific tabs.

When finished, 
 click OK. The system will save your record. You will have to perform 
 a session refresh in order for security settings 
 to take effect.

A mass security change lets you define user, group or system-level security 
 that affects all system windows in one step. This is especially helpful 
 if you want to create a system-level record for all windows, or grant 
 a user access to all windows. If you want to perform a mass change to 
 the Security Permissions Window, create a user-level record that can access both this 
 window and the Configurations Explorer. The system will not allow you 
 to deny access to the Security Window in a mass change unless one record 
 exists that can open it. This safeguard ensures you are not locked out 
 the Security Window.

Manually select the windows 
 you want to set security for. You may select All, Processing or Configurations windows to be displayed.

Choose the Select All option from the Actions Menu. The system 
 will select all the windows from the forms list.

Use the Security Level Field 
 to indicate if you want to create a user-level, group level, or system-level security 
 record.               If you create a user-level 
 record, use the User Name Field to select the user that you are 
 creating the security record for. If you select Group level, enter or select the group.

Use the Checkpoints Checkboxes 
 to select the actions that you want to allow the user to perform 
 on these windows.

Click OK. 
 The system will create security records for the windows you selected. 
 You will have to perform a session refresh in 
 order for security settings to take effect.
Copying a User Profile to a Security Permissions Group or User...
Click OK. The user profile is displayed.
From the Actions Menu, select either Copy user Security Permissions 'To Group' or 'To User; Option.
From the Copy Permissions To Window, select the destination group or user.
Click OK to update and copy.
